panels.title: Latest annual rate
panels.description: Average interest rate of credit operations to individuals (total, % a.a.) in the latest reference month in range. SGS 20716.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Change vs 12 months earlier
panels.description: Latest rate in range minus the rate of the same month one year earlier, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS ref_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change
FROM l
JOIN d c ON c.ref_dt = l.ref_dt
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (l.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE

panels.title: Range min / max
panels.description: Lowest and highest monthly rate (% a.a.) in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  min(value)::DOUBLE AS "Min",
  max(value)::DOUBLE AS "Max"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest reference month
panels.description: Most recent reference month in range. BACEN publishes this series with a lag of about two months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS ref_month
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Average annual rate
panels.description: Monthly average interest rate of credit operations to individuals (total, % a.a.) and its trailing 12-month average.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
m AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value,
    avg(value) OVER w AS avg_12m,
    count(*) OVER w AS months
  FROM d
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ref_dt RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 11 MONTH PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Rate",
  CASE WHEN months = 12 THEN avg_12m::DOUBLE END AS "12-month average"
FROM m
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Month-over-month change
panels.description: Rate minus the previous month's rate, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 2 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
c AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    CASE WHEN lag(ref_dt) OVER w = (ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE THEN value - lag(value) OVER w END AS change
  FROM d
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ref_dt)
)
SELECT ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, change::DOUBLE AS "Month-over-month"
FROM c
WHERE change IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Year-over-year change
panels.description: Rate minus the rate of the same month one year earlier, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 13 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS "Year-over-year"
FROM d c
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Yearly summary
panels.description: Calendar-year statistics (% a.a.) for every year overlapping the range, using all published months of each year; change is the last value vs the previous year's last value.

targets.rawSql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT
    year(ref_dt) AS year,
    count(*) AS months,
    avg(value) AS average,
    min(value) AS min,
    max(value) AS max,
    arg_max(value, ref_dt) AS last,
    max(ref_dt) AS last_dt
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
  year,
  months,
  average::DOUBLE AS average,
  min::DOUBLE AS min,
  max::DOUBLE AS max,
  last::DOUBLE AS end_of_year,
  strftime(last_dt, '%Y-%m') AS last_month,
  (last - lag(last) OVER (ORDER BY year))::DOUBLE AS change
FROM y
QUALIFY year >= year($__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY year DESC

panels.title: Monthly values
panels.description: Latest 24 reference months in range with month-over-month and year-over-year changes in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_household_credit_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT
  strftime(c.ref_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  c.value::DOUBLE AS rate,
  (c.value - m.value)::DOUBLE AS mom_change,
  (c.value - y.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change
FROM d c
LEFT JOIN d m ON m.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
LEFT JOIN d y ON y.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY c.ref_dt DESC
LIMIT 24
